name: Pipeliners - OTTO FAQ Backups 2026-08-26
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-08-26

# Summary
Backups taken before removing duplicate OTTO FAQs from city pages. Sources: `otto-nlpfaq-backup-2026-08-26.md` and the `otto-faq-backup\` folder (`otto-faq-ORIGINAL-verbatim-2026-08-27.json` and `otto-faq-migrated-nodash-2026-08-27.json`).

# nlp_faq rollback (Aug 26)
- 8 city pages served two FAQs and two FAQPage blocks (an OTTO one on top of the Elementor one): Phoenix, Tempe, Glendale, Paradise Valley, Mesa, Chandler, Florence, Fort McDowell. 239 items, all deployed.
- OTTO's 30 questions per page were generic and never named the city.
- `nlp_faq` deployment was switched OFF for those 8 (reversible: items stay stored in OTTO; the file lists each otto_url_id and the restore call).
- Not touched then: San Tan Valley, and the custom_content FAQ pages (Maricopa, Superior, Gold Canyon, Litchfield Park), homepage, /what-is-cipp/ and two posts.

# custom_content migration (Aug 27)
The OTTO FAQ copy from Maricopa, Superior, Gold Canyon and Litchfield Park (48 Q&A pairs) was saved verbatim, em dashes removed, and migrated into Elementor. OTTO has no rollback for custom_content, so the JSON backups are the only copy of the original text.
